page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.8-64 is a flexible virtual machine instance powered by the 64-bit Arm Neoverse-based Ampere Altra processor. This shape is provisioned with 8 dedicated physical cores operating at a sustained clock speed of 3.0 GHz, corresponding to 8 vCPUs with a single thread per core. The dedicated CPU architecture avoids hyperthreading contention, delivering predictable compute execution per core without thread resource sharing.

The instance features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. This 1:8 core-to-memory ratio positions the configuration as a memory-dense environment relative to standard general-purpose profiles. The configuration does not include local storage or hardware GPU accelerators, necessitating network-attached block volumes for operating system disks and persistent file storage. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

By leveraging Ampere Altra Arm architecture, this instance offers high resource density and operational cost efficiency compared to legacy x86 platforms. The dedicated core model delivers stable performance across concurrent execution threads, though applications must support the AArch64 instruction set. Typical suitable workloads include in-memory databases, Redis caches, memory-intensive container clusters, data transformation pipelines, and native Arm software development environments.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.8-64 is an Arm-based virtual machine configured with 8 dedicated Ampere Altra cores operating at 3.0 GHz. Because each core runs a single thread, the instance supplies 8 full physical execution pipelines without hyperthreading interference. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a high 8.0 GB per-core allocation suitable for memory-heavy processing tasks. The instance includes no integrated local storage or GPU hardware, relying on external block storage services for data persistence, and provides one complimentary public IPv4 address. The combination of power-efficient AArch64 architecture and generous memory capacity provides strong cost efficiency for scale-out applications. VM.Standard.A1.Flex.8-64 is well suited for memory-intensive workloads including Redis caching layers, in-memory databases, web application backends, and multi-threaded Arm compilation pipelines.
